## `neuro.iterator.flatMap`

Instance method on `Iterator.prototype`.

> Creates an iterator whose values are the result of applying the callback to the values from this iterator and then flattening the resulting iterators or iterables.

## Signatures

```ts
flatMap(input: { iterator: <receiver>; callback?: (value: T; index: number) => Iterator<U; unknown; undefined> | Iterable<U; unknown; undefined>; prompt?: string }): Promise<IteratorObject<U, undefined, unknown>>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Iterator.prototype.flatMap` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
